summary: OR Royalties Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, furnishing a press release with preliminary Q3 2026 results rather than announcing a special situation. The company earned 20,237 attributable gold equivalent ounces, recorded preliminary royalty and stream revenues of $90.2 million, cost of sales of $2.9 million, and a quarterly cash margin of approximately $87.3 million, or 96.8%. Cash stood near $76.7 million after $29.1 million of buybacks under a normal course issuer bid. The La Verde royalty deal with Hot Chili closed for $15.0 million. What to watch: Q3 results on November 11 and conference call November 12, 2026.
